name: Østerdalsleden
description_md:
Oesterdalsleden is a hard waymarked hiking route in Norway spanning 377.0 km. The national waymarked hiking network route is signposted as PØ and matches the official route published by turrutebasen.

The trail includes 8020 m of ascent and 8228 m of descent. Walking the route takes about 116 hours on the DIN 33466 hiking time rule. The difficulty is derived from distance and ascent. Near the end, the route passes Nidaros Cathedral within 100 m and Trondheim within 200 m.
